## `src/error.rs`

### type `Result`

The result type every fallible `Jail` operation returns.

```rust
pub type Result<T> = std::result::Result<T, Error>;
```

### enum `Error`

Everything that can go wrong resolving or touching a path inside a `Jail`.

```rust
#[derive(Debug)]
pub enum Error {
    Escape(String),
    NotFound(String),
    NotAFile(String),
    NotText(String),
    AlreadyExists(String),
    Io {
        path: String,
        source: io::Error,
    },
}
```

## `src/lib.rs`

### struct `Jail`

An isolated filesystem confined to one base directory. Cheap to clone; holds only the base path. Construct one per root you want to expose (e.g. a project's directory).

```rust
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct Jail {
    base: PathBuf,
}
```

### struct `Entry`

One entry in a directory listing: its name plus lightweight stats. `is_dir` and `size`/`modified` follow symlinks (they describe the target); `is_symlink` records whether the entry itself is a link.

```rust
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct Entry {
    pub name: String,
    pub is_dir: bool,
    pub is_symlink: bool,
    pub size: u64,
    pub modified: Option<u64>,
}
```

### struct `Metadata`

Lightweight metadata for a single path (`Jail::metadata`).

```rust
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct Metadata {
    pub is_dir: bool,
    pub is_file: bool,
    pub is_symlink: bool,
    pub size: u64,
    pub modified: Option<u64>,
}
```
